name: Vespella de Gaià (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white wavy stripe near the lower edge, charged at the centre with a white sword with a yellow hilt, point upward.
history: Municipal flag of Vespella de Gaià; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy stripe near the lower edge
sword with its point upward at the centre
